title: game/data/maps/<id>.json: a walkable map (a town, a route, a room or a test scene)

edge.description: the ground kind (a key of scenery.terrains) round the map

tiles.description: the ground, a row of ground-kind keys per metre (h rows of w)

heights.description: the land's height at each metre corner ((h+1) rows of w+1)

people.description: people who only talk (Project Story: their script; when / unless: there only while the story allows)

rot.description: degrees it is turned about its base point (the middle of its front): positive turns its right-hand end away from you; -180 to 180

tilt.description: HB-6: a model's lean about its base point: degrees its top leans toward its own right-hand end (+x) and toward its back (+z); a few degrees at most

cam.description: the walking camera: tilt (degrees), height (m), field of view; island track: orbit

orbit.description: island track: the camera sits out over the sea and looks in at c; inside dead metres of c the yaw holds; lag: seconds the yaw takes to follow; turn: degrees the player may still turn it

island.description: island track: the island's middle and its coastline, a closed polygon (the last point joins the first)

zones.description: island track: areas of the island; a locked zone's ground and props are never touched when the island is made again

plots.description: island track: building plots the island generator laid out (IS-2): where a building of kind k may stand, its middle (x, z), width along its street, depth, the angle its front faces (degrees, 0 east, 90 north) and the level its pad was made at; the buildings themselves are props

islandGen.description: island track: the island generator's version, seed and dials (IS-2 owns the dials), so the ground can be made again; lock and hash freeze the ground

lock.description: the ground is frozen: a change to it fails the data check (props stay free)

waterKind.description: the kind of the map's water (walk/water-data.js WATER_KIND_LOOKS)

camZones.description: CAM-2: camera zones (walk/camera.js): standing in one, the camera takes its zoom, tilt and aim offset; the highest priority wins. rect: x, z (corner), w, h; circle: x, z (centre), r. Metres.
